name: magic_gesture
text: A standing magician presents the open left palm face-up at waist height, sweeps the right hand slowly above the left palm in a circular flourish, then opens both arms outward to reveal the empty hands. A clear three-part flourish: present palm, sweep over it, spread both arms. No object and no finger trick.
hand_target: Raise left hand up to 16cm while the hands approach, preserving the right palm presentation

review.notes_zh: 右手在腹前托掌，左手在其上方扫过并上扬展示，最后放下；纠正两手同高相穿，检查两手关节点最小间距约12厘米。不是手指魔术、物品凭空出现或双臂大幅展开。
